Karandikar Director, Chennai Mathematical Institute Copulas, Tail dependence and Value at Risk 24 Multivariate Distribution with double exponential marginals Question: How do we construct a joint distribution in m-dimension where all marginals are double exponential and all rank correlations are say 0.75. Karandikar Director, Chennai Mathematical Institute Copulas, Tail dependence and Value at Risk 25 Multivariate Distribution with double exponential marginals One answer: Let X = (X1,X2,...,Xm) have multivariate normal distribution with mean vector 0, all variances equal to one and all (Pearson) correlations equal to 0.75. results.title: Copula Analysis of Risk: A Multivariate Risk Analysis for VaR and CoVaR using Copulas and DCC-GARCH
results.content: # Copula Analysis of Risk: A Multivariate Risk Analysis for VaR and CoVaR using Copulas and DCC-GARCH. A multivariate risk analysis for VaR and CVaR using different copula families is performed on historical financial time series fitted with DCC-GARCH models.
